title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
马寻内心满满的都是振奋，住在皇宫里虽然舒服，可是总觉得不太自由。看着眼前占地十几亩的宅院，马寻的内心还是有些震撼。三进的院子什么暂且不说，还有亭台楼阁、假山，还配了个小小的练武场。朱樉献宝一般的说道，“舅舅，这宅子以前是前元守将的宅子。本来是赏给谢再兴的，那人跑去投张士诚了，被父皇收回来了。谢再兴是朱元璋早期大将，大女儿嫁给朱元璋亲侄子朱文正、小女儿许给徐达。结果他不满意自己的地位，叛降张士诚，后来被李文忠给活捉了。朱棡也跟着说道，“舅舅，我看这宅子还是小了点，配不上您！舅舅，外甥帮您来布置宅子如何？”马寻立刻提高警惕，问道，“你？算了，我没钱让你瞎弄。收拾一下就行了，用不着大兴土木。”朱樉、朱棡立刻失望，他们有很多想法呢，肯定将舅舅的宅子设计的富丽堂皇。可惜舅舅不识货，不相信他们。“母后遣家仆、侍女共三十人，都是母后身边的老人。”朱樉就说道，“侍女也都是岁数到了，放出宫成家。”这也是马秀英的仁慈，一般的宫女一辈子都是在宫中服侍。但是马秀英怜惜她们，所以差不多到了岁数，就让这些宫女出宫，很多也都定好婚事。马寻就开心了，“这最好不过了，我不懂这些。”说话间一个侍卫上前，“国舅，御史中丞长子来了。”刘琏，也就是刘伯温的长子、马寻的准大舅哥，他文学修养极高，极其擅长诗、词，不过现在还没有官职。刘琏见到马寻、朱樉等人也连忙行礼，家教暂且不提，身份还是有差距。马寻就主动说道，“御史中丞本就是极其擅长堪舆之术，我粗鄙不太懂那些。这就麻烦刘兄了，帮忙布置一下府邸。”刘琏也谦虚说道，“国舅言重了，我才学不及家父万一，堪舆之术更是不懂。”朱樉立刻问道，“那我舅母总该知道吧？”朱棡也连忙说道，“谁真的让你来布置了？就是想要让舅母喜欢，干你什么事？”这俩外甥身份尊贵，什么话都直接说。不过他们说的，也确实是马寻的想法。

可是想法归想法，不能说出来啊。“一边去！”马寻不客气的说道，“就说不带你们，非要跟出来，还要不要礼数！”朱樉和朱棡满脸不服气，可是碍于朱元璋和马秀英的威严，现在也不敢说什么。他们自然不怕马寻，可是怕马寻的靠山啊。刘琏心里直跳，两位皇子将话挑明了。而从两位皇子的态度，以及这位国舅爷对待皇子们的态度来看，这些马国舅和皇帝、皇后的关系极为亲近。对于如今的刘家来说，这也算是好消息，因为刘伯温在朝堂不只是被皇帝疏远，被李善长等人也在排挤，都想着告老还乡了。马寻就连忙对刘琏说道，“孩子不懂事，刘兄不要放在心上。”刘琏连忙说道，“不敢。”沉默片刻后，马寻才说道，“要不，刘兄帮忙参议一下？要是刘兄不擅长这些，可请教令尊，或者是其他人？”朱樉和朱棡立刻毫不掩饰的在笑，而刘琏也哭笑不得。这位国舅爷虽然知礼数，可是显然也不太多，也不掩饰了。这哪里是让刘伯温来设计，这就是让刘姝宁来设计。刘琏哪敢对这些事情做主，连忙说道，“国舅见谅，兹事体大，实在不敢自作主张。待我回去后禀明父亲，自有他来安排。”马寻立刻说道，“是这个道理，那刘兄随我走走看看。我也是第一次住这么大、这么秀气的宅子，有些不大习惯。”刘琏如芒在背、如坐针毡，可是他没有选择权。同样没有选择权的是刘伯温，小老头正襟危坐，皇帝和皇后在武英殿招待他呢。皇帝一如既往的冷着脸，刘伯温对此习以为常了。皇帝不待见他，心知肚明的事情。马秀英还是那么的亲切和蔼，让人如沐春风，只是刘伯温越发觉得女儿保不住了。皇后现在的亲切，比以往还要厉害。马秀英安排好饭菜，说道，“刘先生，听闻婉儿说令媛除了女红极佳，也善象纬之学？”刘伯温是个厉害人物，自幼博览经史及天文、历法、兵法、性理诸书，尤精象纬之学。也就是说天文学家、政治家、军事家以及文学家。刘伯温连忙说道，“殿下抬爱，爱女性情跳脱，并非淑雅、才情之人。”
content_en:
Ma Xun's heart was full of excitement. Although living in the palace was comfortable, he still felt not very free.Looking at the house covering an area of ​​more than ten acres in front of him, Ma Xun was still a little shocked.Not to mention the third courtyard, there are pavilions, rockeries, and a small martial arts training ground.Zhu Ping said as if he was offering a treasure, "Uncle, this house used to be the house of the former Yuan Dynasty guard. It was originally awarded to Xie Zaixing, but the man ran to vote for Zhang Shicheng and was taken back by his father. Xie Zaixing was an early general of Zhu Yuanzhang, and his eldest daughter married Zhu Yuanzhang.Yuan Zhang's nephew Zhu Wenzheng and his youngest daughter were promised to Xu Da.As a result, he was dissatisfied with his status and rebelled against Zhang Shicheng.Later, he was captured alive by Li Wenzhong. Zhu Fan also said, "Uncle, I think this house is too small for you!"Uncle, how about your nephew help you decorate the house?Ma Xun immediately became more vigilant and asked, "You?"Forget it, I don't have the money for you to mess around.Just tidy it up, no need for extensive construction work."Zhu Pang and Zhu Fan were immediately disappointed. They had many ideas, and they would definitely design their uncle's house to be magnificent. It's a pity that their uncle didn't know the goods and didn't believe them. "The queen sent a total of thirty servants and maids, all of whom were old people around her.Zhu Xi said, "The maids are all old enough to be released from the palace to start a family.""This is also Ma Xiuying's kindness. Most palace ladies serve in the palace all their lives. But Ma Xiuying took pity on them, so she let these palace ladies leave the palace when they were almost old, and many of them also made arrangements for marriage. Ma Xun was happy, "This is the best, I don't understand this."As he spoke, a guard came forward and said, "Uncle, the eldest son of the Censor Zhongcheng is here."Liu Lian, Liu Bowen's eldest son and Ma Xun's quasi-eldest brother-in-law, has a high level of literary accomplishment and is very good at poetry and lyrics, but he does not have an official position yet. When Liu Lian saw Ma Xun, Zhu Ping and others, he also quickly saluted. Putting aside his tutoring, there was still a gap in status. Ma Xun took the initiative and said, "The censor Zhongcheng is very good at the art of public opinion. I don't know much about it.This troubles Brother Liu, please help decorate the mansion."Liu Lian also said modestly, "My uncle's words are serious. I can't learn as well as my father, and I don't understand the art of public relations.Zhu Xi immediately asked, "Then my aunt should know, right?"Zhu Fan also said quickly, "Who really asked you to arrange it?"I just want my aunt to like me, so what are you doing?"These two nephews have high status and speak directly. But what they said is indeed Ma Xun's idea.

But ideas are just ideas and cannot be expressed."Go aside!"Ma Xun said unceremoniously, "I said I won't take you with me, but I have to follow you out. Do you have to be polite?"Zhu Xiang and Zhu Fan looked unconvinced, but due to the majesty of Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying, they did not dare to say anything now. Naturally, they were not afraid of Ma Xun, but they were afraid of Ma Xun's backers. Liu Lian's heart jumped, and the two princes made their words clear. Judging from the attitudes of the two princes and the uncle's attitude towards the princes,These Uncle Ma were very close to the emperor and the empress.This was good news for the current Liu family, because Liu Bowen was not only alienated by the emperor in the court, but also ostracized by Li Shanchang and others. They all thought about resigning and returning home.Ma Xun quickly said to Liu Lian, "Brother Liu, don't take it to heart."Liu Lian said quickly, "I don't dare.After a moment of silence, Ma Xuncai said, "How about Brother Liu help us discuss this?"If Brother Liu is not good at this, can you ask your father-in-law or others for advice?"Zhu Fang and Zhu Fan immediately laughed without concealing it, and Liu Lian couldn't laugh or cry either. Although the uncle-in-law knew the etiquette, he obviously didn't have too much, and he didn't hide it. This is not for Liu Bowen to design, but for Liu Shuning to design. How dare Liu Lian make the decision on these matters, and said quickly, "I'm sorry, but this is a big matter and I really don't dare to make my own decisions.I will tell my father when I get back and he will make arrangements.Ma Xun immediately said, "That's the truth. Then Brother Liu, come with me and take a look."This is also the first time for me to live in such a big and elegant house, so I am not used to it."Liu Lian felt like he was sitting on pins and needles, but he had no choice. The little old man who also had no choice was Liu Bowen. The little old man was sitting upright. The emperor and the queen were entertaining him in Wuying Hall. The emperor had the same cold face as always, and Liu Bowen was used to it. The emperor didn't want to see him, and he knew it well.Ma Xiuying is still so kind and kind, but Liu Bowen feels more and more that the queen is more kind than before.Ma Xiuying arranged the meal and said, "Mr. Liu, I heard that Qingyuan is not only a good female beauty, but also good at Xiangwei's school?""Liu Bowen is a powerful figure. He has read extensively in classics and history, astronomy, calendars, art of war, and human nature since he was a child. He is especially proficient in the study of Xiangwei. That is to say, he is an astronomer, politician, military strategist, and writer. Liu Bowen said quickly, "Your Highness admires love and loves women. He is not an elegant and talented person."
